ios.desc:
A fully offline money tracker that also shows how many days your money will last.
Enter income, expenses, and recurring bills, and your runway updates instantly.
Set category limits. View clear reports. Export your data when you need to.
Your data stays on your device, with automatic iCloud backups for recovery at any time.
No ads. No sign-ups. No tracking.
A clean, familiar calculator-based design that works right away.
